contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Urbs Roma commemorative issue of Lyon mint, 330-331, RIC vol. 7 no. 242. Obverse description: Helmeted and mantled bust of Roma left. Obverse inscription: [VRBS] ROMA. Reverse description: Wolf suckling twins, two stars above. In exergue: . PLG. Diameter: 16.3mm, Weight: 1.89gms, die axis: 12
